strongest_angle: Investigating how Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus allegedly falsified and backdated at least 1,000 corporate papers to help Roman Abramovich conceal luxury assets and evade taxes.

key_facts.fact: Accountancy firm Deloitte Cyprus helped falsify documents to hide Roman Abramovich's luxury assets including superyachts, mansions, and private jets worth $672m.
Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers on behalf of Roman Abramovich using fake timestamps.
Staff at the global accountancy firm Deloitte participated in backdating records outlining Roman Abramovich's sprawling offshore business empire.
